in_marathi.name: Samrithi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Achieving Peace and Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Samrithi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Samrithi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Samruthi', which means 'achieving peace and prosperity'. It signifies the attainment of balance, harmony, and calmness in one's life.
